title: ml_entry_eq* re-decides the last decision close after every trader restart (in-process memo), so a restart within max_snapshot_age_h (4h) of a close can enter a package late, incl. after the RTH close
note: Found 2026-11-11 22:40Z by lane ML-ENTRY-EQ-STRUCT-FULL-POOL. Evidence: journalctl ict-trader-live 'pool_scored bar=2026-11-11T20:00' logged at 21:11, 21:24, 22:01, 22:22Z (four processes after restarts/deploys; RTH closed 21:00Z), each re-scoring the 20:00Z close because the decided memo (src/runtime/ml_pool_scoring._DECIDED, previously strategy_signal_builders) lives in memory. All four were 0 packages (below_tau), so no late order happened. Risk: a package found on re-decision is entered at a stale close price, possibly with the market shut. Fix options: persist decided (leg, bar_close) to data_dir, or refuse when now > bar_close + one bar / outside RTH. Done = a restart after a close does not re-emit (test + journal). [2026-11-12 13:37Z AM-ML] Dispatched lane session_01AFoLuNEreJyV8Gfp59zGTM (claude-opus-5-5, fresh, $10) for the 11-15 surge slot, a day early. The brief carries the row text and the operator's 11:45Z no-new-gates line verbatim. 2026-11-12 ~13:55Z lane session_01AFoLuNEreJyV8Gfp59zGTM: PR #25342 (draft, Tier 2, landing hold; head 130bbd16a) persists the decided memo to data_dir/ml_entry_eq/decided_<leg>.json + a persisted pool-refused set, so a close is decided once across restarts. No new refusal. Planted/clean tests (tests/test_ml_pool_decided_persist.py) fail with persistence off and pass with it. MEASURED (journalctl ict-trader-live via diag relay, read 2026-11-12 ~13:42Z; 7d asked but journal retention starts 2026-11-11 ~17Z under the journald cap of VM-DISK-GROWTH-20261102; complete scans, 181830 + 406909 lines): 14 pool_scored lines, all bar=2026-11-11T20:00Z, from 7 processes (21:11, 21:24, 22:01, 22:22, 23:23, 23:41, 23:55Z; all after the 21:00Z RTH close), 0 packages, so no late order. PROPOSAL FOR THE OPERATOR (not built: a new limitation needs their permission): also refuse an ml_entry_eq* package when now > bar_close + one bar or outside RTH. Evidence: today's fix stops a re-decision but not a FIRST decision that happens late (e.g. a trader down across a close, or a snapshot written late); in the measured window every post-close score was a re-decision with 0 packages, so no observed loss yet. Done-observation still owed after deploy: a restart within 4h of a close logs 'decided memo loaded' and no ml_entry_eq*_eval side=buy for that close.
